parsed.summary: The netlist implements the specified architecture: 24 V input protection/fusing, TPS62933 buck to 5 V, AZ1117 LDO to 3.3 V, two ADM3260 isolated I2C channels for pH/EC, non-isolated RTD on the main I2C bus, three TMC2209 drivers with correct sense/reference/UART/STEP/EN connections, and low-side pump/valve switches with flyback diodes. Reference-number shifts and unwired/DNP/firmware-pin mismatches are documented or do not indicate a functional deviation supported by the files.
